meta.resultsSource: Delaware Department of Elections, 2026 General Election results by county (official)
meta.landSource: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census Redistricting Data (P.L. 94-171), county land area (AREALAND)
meta.countyRow: counties[i] = [Democratic votes, Republican votes, all other votes, total votes] for meta.counties[i]
sources: Delaware Department of Elections, 2026 General Election results, by county: official results, data as of Nov. 10, 2026, with all 530 election districts reporting; retrieved 2026-11-21.

Delaware Open Data Portal, Official Election Results by Office (provided by the Department of Elections; License: Public Domain): the statewide totals, which the county figures add up to exactly for every candidate.
Write-in votes are in the Department's separate write-in report and aren't counted here. Wilmington is counted in New Castle County. Legislative, county and other local races aren't here.
U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census Redistricting Data (P.L. 94-171): county land area and codes, cities, and each block's location and adults, for placing dots within a county.

U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 TIGER/Line® Shapefiles, tabulation blocks: where people were counted, for keeping dots off empty land. TIGER/Line® is a registered trademark of the Census Bureau; the land grid here isn't a Census Bureau product.
U.S. Census Bureau, Cartographic Boundary Files, 2017 counties, via us-atlas v3.0.1 (counties-10m.json).
Software: three.js r160, d3-geo 3.1.1, topojson-client 3.1.0.
